Synthetic 128 × 96 uncompressed DNG CFA fixture, generated for this project.
Each native sensor sample is `64 + (x*17 + y*11 + (x*y)%31) % 4000`.
RGGB mosaic; black 64; white 4095; identity DNG ColorMatrix1; neutral white
balance; TIFF orientation 1. It contains no thumbnail and no personal data.

SHA-256: `85efd1a3a59b438c1a5e3fd9af52cfaaaa40d118d968edf59733bd5723ff1c47`.
The RGB16 oracle is the deterministic LibRaw 0.22.2 WebAssembly development
under the explicitly tested linear ProPhoto D65/AHD settings. The test also
compares every sensor sample against the formula and checks all orientations.

Additional sensor-only fixtures are regenerated by `create-sensor-fixtures.py`.
`sensor-fixtures.json` pins their encoded and complete unpacked-payload hashes.
The uint16 image contains below-black and above-white codes and an odd DNG
ActiveArea. LibRaw normalizes the active Bayer margins (5,3) to (6,4), while
retaining all128×96 sensor values. The float32 fixture contains negative values,
fractional values, values above one and signed zero. Sensor-only tests do not
call development. They keep sensor orientation separate from display geometry.
